# L'Imperial Kenitra

> Warm Italian-Moroccan bistro in Kenitra, Morocco — handmade pasta, slow brunch, Atlantic seafood, and mint tea.

L'Imperial is a family-run restaurant on Avenue Mohammed V, Kenitra. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 08:00–23:30. Cuisine blends Italian classics with Moroccan flavors.
